items.lede: Instagram is experimenting with longform video again.
items.title: Instagram wants you to watch 90-minute videos on your TV

items.lede: As Instagram rolls out long form videos of up to 90 minutes, the platform has an opportunity to challenge YouTube if it plays its cards right.
items.title: Watch out, YouTube — Instagram goes from short-form to 90-minute videos

items.lede: Instagram’s long-form video update is more than a swipe at YouTube. It’s an attempt to capture the clip economy.
items.title: Instagram Is a Streaming Service Now
